candidate.answerReason: The figure labels the base area as 9 and the height as 3. Thus the cone volume is \(9\times3/3=9\), agreeing with the key.

methods.label: Cone volume
methods.explanation: The volume of a pyramid or cone is one third that of a prism or cylinder with the same base area and height: \(9\times3/3=9\).
methods.levelReason: The cone-to-cylinder volume relationship and elementary multiplication and division are within the stated curriculum.
